Verse of the Day
For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
Job 19:25
Quote of the Day
"Sometimes I need the perspective that time gives to see the refining and perfecting hand of our Savior, Jesus Christ, in my life."
